description: Voz en off impersonal sobre motion graphics / kinetic typography / ilustración animada estilo explainer (whiteboard, character-anim 2D). NO fotorrealismo, NO actores. Estilo educativo dinámico con diagramas, flechas, numbers, before/after morphing.

category.description: Narración sin personaje en pantalla. Foco en gráficos + concepto.

format.description: Motion graphics / explainer animado, no fotorrealista.

visualStyle.promptTemplate: Bold flat-design 2D motion graphics illustration in explainer-video style, vertical 9:16, vibrant minimal color palette (cream background with single accent color per scene — coral / teal / mustard), thick outline strokes, clean geometric shapes, kinetic-typography-ready composition with central focal element and ample negative space for text overlays, no photo-realism, no actors, no characters with faces — focus on diagrams, vessels, anatomical schematics, numbers, arrows, before/after morphing icons. Style references: Kurzgesagt explainer videos, In a Nutshell, animated medical infographics.
visualStyle.negativePrompt: photograph, photo-realistic, 3D render, Pixar, watercolor, oil painting, complex shading, busy detail, actors, faces, talking head
